x-authentication-guide.description:
This API is protected by Amazon Cognito. To use the API:

1. **Via Website**: If you are logged into the DIY Accounting Submit website, you can access the Swagger UI directly and API calls will use your existing session cookies.

2. **External Access**: 
   - First complete the Cognito hosted UI OAuth flow to get an authorization code
   - Exchange that code for an access token by calling `/api/v1/cognito/token`
   - Include the token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header

3. **For HMRC Integration**: Some endpoints require HMRC authorization tokens obtained via `/api/v1/hmrc/token`

**Note**: All endpoints require proper CORS headers and are accessible from the same domain as the main application.
